text:
The court should dismiss on **Speech or Debate Clause immunity** (U.S. Const. art. I, §6, cl. 1), which protects a senator's floor speech absolutely, whatever the falsity or fault allegations. The team note's sovereign-immunity ground doesn't fit, because the officer sued the senator personally, not the federal government. The negligence-versus-actual-malice gap would matter only if the Clause did not apply.

CONFIDENCE: 80
